meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为ADHD读者调整输出格式，突出行动项和进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的读者容易分心，需要清晰的结构和行动指引
copy.tagline_en: Format output for ADHD readers, highlighting next actions and progress
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your readers get distracted easily and need clear structure and action guidance

howto.what: Claude 会以行动开头，用编号列出多步骤任务，每轮对话重申当前进度，给出具体时间估计，抑制无关话题，并让已完成的工作可见。
howto.when: 当你说出触发词“/i-have-adhd”时激活，直到你说“stop adhd mode”才关闭。

say.text: 帮我写一个登录功能，用 /i-have-adhd
say.note: Claude 会以具体步骤开头，而不是先解释背景。
Claude 会详细解释，但依然没有开场白和结束语。
关闭该技能，恢复默认回复风格。

howto.what_en: Claude leads with the next action, numbers multi-step tasks, restates progress each turn, gives specific time estimates, suppresses tangents, and makes completed work visible.
howto.when_en: Activated when you say "/i-have-adhd". Stays on until you say "stop adhd mode".

say_en.note: Claude starts with concrete steps, not context.
Claude explains fully but without preamble or closing.
Deactivates the skill, reverting to default style.
